reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed: the policy exists in an executed migration (not dead code), the attack entry point is an unauthenticated-to-authenticated Supabase SELECT (no trusted-source exclusion applies), and supabase/migrations/ is explicitly in scope. The spec violation is confirmed — migration L53-54 creates an unconditional USING (true) SELECT policy for the authenticated role on member.team_leaders, directly contradicting the property assertion that has_policy(team_leaders, authenticated, ANY) == false. Classified as CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY because the downstream impact (targeted privilege escalation using exposed leader UUIDs) is plausible but not concretely demonstrated; the immediate confirmed impact is full enumeration of organizational leadership assignments by any authenticated club member.
